description_en: Configures the post-processing scripts of a cluster

kebab_example: aliyun ehpc set-post-scripts --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --cluster-id ehpc-sh-EnjshUxn --post-install-scripts Args=-h Url=https://bucket.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/postscript_examples.sh --api-version 2018-04-12 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SetPostScripts
